plugins.name: impeccable-microdots
plugins.description: Design fluency for MicroDots (Effect v4 + Foldkit). A fork of Impeccable by Paul Bakaus (Apache-2.0), adapted for hyperscript views, a test-enforced semantic token vocabulary, and a variant preview harness that runs the dot's real program. Invoked as /impeccable-microdots:impeccable. For any non-MicroDots project use upstream Impeccable.
